subject: Film & Cinema
title: Martial Arts Cinema Goes Global
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Martial Arts Cinema Goes Global.

hook.text: Bruce Lee kicked open Hollywood's door — literally and figuratively.

buildup.text: Hong Kong martial arts films combined philosophy, choreography, and jaw-dropping stunts.

discovery.text: Jackie Chan added comedy. Jet Li added grace. Each star created a distinct style.

twist.text: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon proved martial arts could win Oscars and art-house fans.

climax.text: Today, martial arts choreography influences every major action franchise.

quiz.question: Who first brought martial arts cinema to global mainstream audiences?
